item.title: After Compaction, What Does AI Still Remember?——State Retention Mechanism
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's context compaction state retention mechanism: lossy compression design, metadata preservation, the role of reference links, and how AI elegantly makes tradeoffs when "memory runs out."

item.title: 200K Context Window——AI's "Memory Palace" Management
